incident.summary: Live $ask webgpt tau-dag run blocked at browser provider availability preflight. Chrome had crashed and was stuck at the profile picker: no profile loaded, no surf extension, no native host, no /tmp/surf.sock. Ask correctly failed closed with blocked_reason browser_provider_unavailable_preflight and failure_code surf_browser_connection_unavailable instead of dispatching Tau or retrying provider lanes. Recovery: relaunch Chrome with --profile-directory=Default (bypasses the picker), after which the extension spawned the native host and tab.list worked.

fail_before_fix.expected: non-zero exit with failure_code surf_tab_list_failed in the output artifact; proves the availability guard detects a dead surf transport instead of passing vacuously

regressions.notes: The preflight behaved correctly during the incident (fail-closed, named code, runnable next_command). This regression retains that behavior: if the probe ever exits zero or drops the failure_code when surf transport is down, the guard has been weakened.
